description.p: KineticOS Configurator clones, opens, configures, updates, resets, and builds a Kineticos image project. A guided wizard walks through the base image, per-module app selection, optional repositories and removals, then writes profile.yaml and modules/*.yaml and runs dcli-bootc gen.

After generation the configurator can run dcli-bootc build and, with confirmation, switch to the new image and reboot. Reset creates a full backup before restoring the selected project to the latest upstream template.

Rewrite in GTK 4 (gtkmm) and libadwaita, following the GTK Desktop Application Standard: standard window shell, live desktop theming, settings.ini, About dialog and help window. The earlier Python configurator is kept for reference only.
Restyle to the GTK Desktop Application Standard: standard window shell, theming, and settings.ini.
Add Yes/No controls for the user Flatpak build prompt, make package removals opt-in, keep base packages mandatory, and couple browser vendor repositories to app choices.
Package the integrated configurator, workspace clone flow, and in-app build actions.
